# Headlight assembly replacement and alignment

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Replace and align the 2nd-generation Nissan Xterra's headlight assembly by swapping housings and adjusting beams. [t481]

## Tools

- Screwdriver [t481]
- 10mm socket and impact drill [t481]
- [Partial] #2 Phillips screwdriver or 8mm socket [t481]

## Parts

- [Partial] Headlight housing, OEM or CAPA certified [t481]
- [Partial] New hardware bolts for headlight mounting [t481]

## Tips & gotchas

- Perform the job on pairs of headlights rather than individually. [t481]
- Use CAPA certified aftermarket TYC housings if OEM is too expensive, as they fit well and finish nicely. [t481]
- Ensure the fuel tank is full and cargo area empty to simulate unloaded vehicle weight for accurate aiming. [t481]

## Common mistakes

- [Partial] Yanking the bumper off too hard which busts the retaining clip lock beneath the front fender. [t481]
- [Partial] Overtorquing the headlight mounting bolts, potentially breaking the fasteners or surrounding plastic. [t481]
